profile.headline: Software Development Manager/End-to-End Solutions Engineer at Agape Systems, LLC

positions.title: Contractor - Development Manager/Principal Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description:
Support commercial, non-profit, and federal clients across industries through the discovery, architecture, design, and development of enterprise and consumer software solutions. Solutions include XR surgical augmentation, business process automation, customer relationship management, resource management, project management, telecommunications services, commercial property insurance, EMR, patient navigation, health care claims, scheduling, and geospatial tools.

● Manage agile architecture, development, and QA teams across short- and long-term projects
● Lead design, development, modernization, and hardening of enterprise and consumer software
● Define and execute processes for iterative improvement of development cycles
● Architected and led development of a unified business and client operations SaaS platform built on OpenAI GPT-4 models, .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL Server, Docker, on AWS.
● Architected and led development of an Ethereum-based NFT marketplace and social network. Built with React/Remix, Node, GraphQL, Ethers.js, PostgresSQL, MongoDB, using serverless, event-driven and microservices architectures on GCP.
● Multi-endpoint XR surgical augmentation solution targeting VR headsets and .NET/C# desktop front-end with embedded Chromium. RPC and messaging via SignalR. IR point-cloud tracking using OptiTrack APIs; virtual theater via Three.js/WebGL; real-time overlays via WebRTC using a proprietary GPU codec in C++ and HLSL.
● Led architecture and development of high-concurrency web-based services solution for billion-dollar telecom. Built with .NET Core, Angular, Oracle, SQL Server, GraphQL, and ESRI APIs.
● Technologies: .NET, Angular, React, Node, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Web Sockets, SignalR, RabbitMQ, WebGL, C++, HLSL, DirectX, OptiTrack, Three.js, WebRTC, ESRI, Lua, SQL, Redis, GraphQL, Hasura, Hot Chocolate, Oracle, Docker, AWS, Azure, GitHub, ClickUp, Jira, PCI, Stripe, PayPal, Square.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Support the United States Department of Agriculture’s (USDA) effort to enhance and modernize their Public Health Information System (PHIS) solution which captures and performs analysis on data pertaining to all animal-based products originating, entering or leaving the US for human consumption.

• Define the software strategy for implementing the USDA Food Safety Inspection Service’s (FSIS) manual and paper-based governance of product exports from the US to over 140 countries. Governance is country specific and subject to change daily.

• Implement sound business analysis processes based upon industry best-practices and the specific nature of the FSIS to improve the accuracy, scope and testability of the software requirements defining the PHIS project.

• Manage and coordinate the efforts of several small development teams working on multiple independent applications that integrate to comprise the PHIS software suite which consists of over 370 projects.

• Evolve the existing PHIS software and system architecture to improve performance, stability, availability, mobility, integration with external agencies and orginizations and reduce long term development effort.

• Define software profiling processes to identify and design solutions to performance bottlenecks across PHIS while minimizing general and integration regressions.

• Cultivate a strong collaborative culture across the multiple teams of the development organization.

• Define continuous integration processes encompassing automated build, testing and deployment. Implemented process has also reduced solution build time from over one hour to less than 20 minutes on the same hardware.

• Design an enhanced, unified auditing model for all data persisted by the PHIS solution.

• Implement agile methods over a policy-driven waterfall software development life cycle.

• Develop and implement best practices and conventions across development teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported the American College of Cardiology’s (ACC) effort to enhance their National Cardiovascular Data Registry (NCDR) solution which houses, aggregates and reports on data in 6 registries from over 3,400 healthcare providers.

• Redesigned, enhanced and standardized NCDR’s auditing capabilities across all 6 registries.

• Lead the restructuring of the solution’s suite of over 100 projects to allow for automating its predominantly manual build and deployment process. Solutions consisted of Windows service, web applications and services constructed using the following technologies: C# 2, 3 and 4, ASP.NET Web Forms 2, 3 and 4, ASP.NET MVC 3 and 4, HTML 4 and 5, JavaScript 1.5 through 1.8, jQuery, Entity Framework 5 and 6, Microsoft Unity 2.0, Microsoft SQL Server 2008 and 2012, and Telerik Sitefinity 7.

• Redesigned and automated NCDRs build and deployment process using Jenkins 1.5 and MSBuild 4, 4.5 and 12 reducing the downtime incurred from a span of several hours down to one hour or less.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
• Supported multiple commercial, federal and military clients through the design, development, maintenance and enhancement of software solutions.
Clients included the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), US Air Force Space Command (AFSPC), US Army Medical Command (US MEDCOM), and US Air Force District of Washington (AFDW).

• Managed and lead development teams in the design of new solutions and re-architecture existing solutions in support of the OCIO of the NNSA. Solutions consisted of highly responsive web-application front-ends built on top of a highly flexible and reusable custom SOA platform developed using the following technologies: Amazon AWS, EC2 and S3, C# 4.0, ASP.NET Web Forms/MVC, WCF, HTML5, JavaScript 1.5 through 1.8.5, AJAX (jQuery), ADO.NET Entity Framework 4, 5 and 6, Microsoft Unity 2.0, MS SQL 2008 R2, and JSON.

• Participated in a team-based effort to develop a web-based real-time event and notification tracking system in support of AFSPC ground and cyber operations using the following technologies: C# 4.0, Silverlight 4, WCF, and MS SQL 2008 R2.

• Sole developer in support of a commercial client requiring an instant messaging bot compatible with Microsoft Lync which could disseminate information and multimedia feeds to thousands of simultaneous users. Bot was required to receive and process both text and speech communications. Multiple disparate sources were queried over a secure channel supporting multiple forms of encryption with OAuth-based authentication. Solution was developed using the following technologies: C# 4.0, Multi-threading, Microsoft Unified Communications Managed API 3.0 SDK, Microsoft Lync Server, OAuth, RESTful web services, and OAuth.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported the National Guard Bureau Joint Operations Center initiatives through the development, maintenance and enhancement of high impact, mission sensitive software solutions.

• Participated in a team-based effort to maintain and enhance the existing flagship operations coordination and information exchange solution used by every state National Guard. Solution consists of an extensively rich web application front-end with extensive client-side UI code base and several web services developed using the following technologies: C#, ASP.NET, WCF, JavaScript, AJAX (jQuery), ADO.NET, Flash, Action Script, Flex, ESRI mapping components and APIs, MS SQL 2005, Crystal Reports engine, JSON, and XML (GeoRSS, CAP 1.1, and proprietary).

• Lead re-architecture of flagship solution refactoring it from a monolithic web application to an SOA platform. Solution vastly expanded the original’s use of WCF and implemented a federated security model enabling collaboration with other government agencies and first responders. Scalable application engine was redeveloped into a Window’s Service exposing web services to be consumed by a rich AJAX web-application front-end, a reporting engine, and state monitoring dashboard. Solutions were developed using the following technologies: .NET Framework 4.0, C#, ADO.NET Entity Framework, WCF, federated claims-based security (WIF) over custom HTTP, TCP and named-pipe bindings, ASP.NET, JavaScript, AJAX (jQuery), Flash, Action Script, Flex, ESRI mapping components and APIs, MS SQL 2008, Crystal Reports engine, JSON, and XML (GeoRSS, CAP 1.1, and proprietary).

• Sole developer tasked to implement a support and information portal for the flagship solution. Portal was constructed using DotNetNuke and custom DotNetNuke modules which consume services exposed by the flagship solution.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Participated in a newly revitalized, team-based development effort to automate health care claim re-pricings for patients insured by overseas health insurance providers when treated at US health care facilities. Project consists of Web- and Windows Services with two Windows Forms desktop application front-ends constructed using the following technologies: C#, ADO.NET, WCF, WPF, WF, Multi-threading, T-SQL, EDI, Crystal Reports engine and view, and Telerik UI Controls.

• Designed and developed .NET library to convert claims data to and from proprietary database to the Electronic Data Interchange standard format (X12/EDI 837) and to construct and interpreted the transmission acknowledgement format (X12/EDI 997).

• Completely redesigned and developed the entire data layer of the project including the database implementation and all data access classes. Facilitated the complete migration to the new data layer within 4 hours using a specially designed wrapper class to first mimic the original data layer structure and ease code changes to the optimized structure.

• Modified Crystal Report designed to generate report data from the original database structure to function using the entirely new structure and extended the data provided by the report. Also optimized the report and the stored procedures it used to enable complete retrieval, compilation, and display of data in less than 4 seconds, down from several minutes depending on the parameters provided.

• Project activities were governed using SCRUM methodologies.

• Assisted in the design and development of an automated document scanning and submission application. Project consists of Web Services and a Windows Forms desktop application front-end constructed using the following technologies: C#, WCF, WPF, Multi-threading, and Infragistics UI Controls.

positions.title: Lead Automations Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported the United States Army’s Program Executive Office (PEO) Rapid Fielding Initiative (RFI) through automating manual processes, digitizing historically handwritten documents, and assisting or leading network and systems administration duties.

• Managed and participated in reverse engineering, refactoring, and extension efforts for numerous current and legacy software solutions including COTS software. Solutions consist of web and desktop applications and web services developed using primarily the following technologies: C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, JavaScript, AJAX (raw XHR, Dojo), ADO.NET, T-SQL, WCF, Active Directory, and GemBox Spreadsheet.

• Analyzed existing user processes, operating environments, and general user proficiency with computers within a given business component to specifically design and develop software and user interfaces to best streamline and expedite business processes while minimizing end-user training and down-time requirements.

• Designed and developed a dynamic user authentication/authorization system using readily available employee, business partner, and client information spread across multiple databases to delegate access and roles to web application users where a centralized user database is not practical.

• Collaborated with third-party development companies to produce interoperating solutions supporting both company and US Army objectives.
Monitored and reported SDLC activities and productivity statistics for the Director of Automation Systems.

• Created and configured virtual machines and environments for testing & debugging activities where actual user-environment equipment is not readily available. Virtual machine environments typically used are VMware Server and VMware Player.

• Authored architecture, design, and testing documents

• Researched, documented and assigned standards, conventions, and technical procedures to improve cohesion amongst software interfaces, source code libraries, and general development activities

• Managed and participated in reverse engineering, refactoring, and extension efforts for numerous current and legacy software solutions including COTS software. Solutions consist of web and desktop applications and web services developed using primarily the following technologies: C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, JavaScript, AJAX (raw XHR, Dojo), ADO.NET, T-SQL, WCF, Active Directory, and GemBox Spreadsheet.

• Analyzed existing user processes, operating environments, and general user proficiency with computers within a given business component to specifically design and develop software and user interfaces to best streamline and expedite business processes while minimizing end-user training and down-time requirements.

• Designed and developed a dynamic user authentication/authorization system using readily available employee, business partner, and client information spread across multiple databases to delegate access and roles to web application users where a centralized user database is not practical.

• Collaborated with third-party development companies to produce interoperating solutions supporting both company and US Army objectives.
Monitored and reported SDLC activities and productivity statistics for the Director of Automation Systems.

• Created and configured virtual machines and environments for testing & debugging activities where actual user-environment equipment is not readily available. Virtual machine environments typically used are VMware Server and VMware Player.

• Authored architecture, design, and testing documents

• Researched, documented and assigned standards, conventions, and technical procedures to improve cohesion amongst software interfaces, source code libraries, and general development activities
